title: pingdotgg/t3code brings multiple coding agents into one minimal interface
friendlyTitle: T3 Code puts four coding agents in one simple app
summary: T3 Code is an MIT-licensed TypeScript web and desktop interface for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode. It led the day’s AI-related GitHub Trending candidates and had about 15,000 stars when checked.
friendlySummary: This fast-rising project gives Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode a shared web or desktop interface.
whyItMatters: Use it to access several authenticated coding-agent CLIs through a consistent graphical workspace, either with npx or a desktop package. The maintainers call the project very early, so expect bugs and test it on non-critical repositories first.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Try it if you want one visual place for different coding agents. It is still very early, so start with code that is backed up and not critical.
